cmd:
TOK=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN= /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
D=/opt/trading-bot/classic
for f in classic_tl_test classic_tl_robust classic_grid; do curl -sfH "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/classic/$f.py" -o $D/$f.py; done
chown -R tbot:tbot $D; cd $D; rm -f out_tl_4h.txt out_rob_4h.txt out_rob_1h.txt out_tl_1h.txt out_grid2.txt
nohup sudo -u tbot /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python classic_tl_test.py 4h > out_tl_4h.txt 2>&1 &
nohup sudo -u tbot /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python classic_tl_robust.py 4h > out_rob_4h.txt 2>&1 &
sleep 3; echo started
